WhatsApp today announced a series of new features on its official blog, including the ability to share Apple Music and Spotify listening activity to WhatsApp Status, changes to account settings for iPad, and more.

WhatsApp announces support for Apple Music sharing, direct iPad registration, and other new features

In addition to launching the first-ever Adobe Acrobat PDF integration today, WhatsApp also simultaneously announced several new and recent feature updates.

One of the new features is the ability to share the music you're currently listening to on Apple Music or Spotify directly to WhatsApp Status. According to the blog post:

There were already signs back in November that this feature was in development, and WhatsApp says it has now been officially rolled out to users.

Another change is that iPad users can now register a WhatsApp account directly on their iPad, without needing to link a phone number. According to today's announcement, this was one of the most requested features since the first launch of WhatsApp for iPad.

Finally, WhatsApp's blog post also highlighted the recently upgraded CarPlay app, which allows users to do much more than before.

Among all these new WhatsApp features above, which one are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share with us in the comment section.
